name: Torque
tagline: Ready-made website for car repair workshops
description: Torque is a website template for car repair workshops and mechanics, with a dark hero where a vertical outlined TORQUE wordmark runs beside a mechanic at work, a price list with times and starting prices, a repair order builder where visitors tick jobs and watch a printed order card add up an estimated total, a workshop gallery, a red band with four promises, a list of car makes, driver reviews with a rating, questions before the visit and a contact section with opening hours. Graphite, light grey and a single workshop red with Oswald headings give the website a direct, honest character. Replace the copy, prices, times, photos, reviews and legal pages with your own before publishing.
features: Hero with a vertical outlined wordmark, a mechanic photo in an offset frame and a rating
Price list of eight jobs with the usual time and starting price
Repair order builder: tick jobs and a printed order card shows each line and an estimated total
Red band with four promises: price before repair, parts you can see, 12 month warranty, fault photos
Car makes the workshop services, as plain text
Driver reviews with car model, date and average rating
Questions before the visit with FAQPage structured data
Three service pages with a scope, time and price table and their own FAQ
Recent repairs page with problem, diagnosis, cost and time
Booking form with a service choice, Polish and English versions
